Existing start/permit/identity reads, heartbeat, settle, reconcile and acknowledgeStopped validate a supplied exact lease. cancel(id,version) is a user-job cancellation, not an exact lease host API; it marks running attempts stopping and retains reservation until stop acknowledgement. No public store method reads an active worker lease, observes cancellation by exact lease, compare-cancels an unstarted claim, or requests active cancellation by exact lease.

A missing journal currently maps worker.reconcile() to idle. SQLite intentionally stores only lease_hash, so it cannot safely reconstruct the lease token.
current_surfaces.service_authority: CloudJobService lazily owns a private currentStore and createCloudJobAuthority creates it through openStore(); the authority source explicitly forces dispatch disabled and liveDispatchReady false until a production host provides readiness. required_host_adapter.proposed_module: dobius/src/main/automations/cloud-jobs/cloud-worker-host-adapter.ts (new), plus cloud-worker-host-adapter.test.ts; this is a composition adapter around ROOT's single existing CloudJobStore and exactly the two enrolled worker/queue pairs, not another store or authority plane.
required_host_adapter.readActiveLease: For the requested constructor-enrolled worker, inspect the worker's authenticated private journal through a narrow WorkstationWorker API returning a tagged exact lease observation; validate the lease against SQLite's unresolved worker attempt by attemptId/workerId/hash before returning active. Never derive a token from lease_hash. Missing/corrupt/mismatched journal while SQLite has an unresolved attempt is unknown, not idle. Return idle only when reconciliation plus an explicit durable no-unresolved-attempt condition establish it; do not equate a missing receipt alone with idle.
required_host_adapter.observeCancellation: Add a store/ledger read-transition API taking WorkerLeaseReceipt, compare worker/attempt/hash in a transaction, and return stopping/not-stopping with the same exact lease only for a matching unresolved row. Expired/interrupted rows should be observed as stopping; terminal/missing/mismatched state is unknown. This callback must not use job ID/version alone or signal processes.
required_host_adapter.cancelUnstartedClaim: Add a transactional compare-and-cancel taking the full WorkerClaim: match attempt, worker and token hash; require current claim and no permit or start receipt; mark the attempt as terminal-unstarted, requeue only if it was still an unstarted running job (otherwise preserve an explicit user cancellation), and delete its capacity reservation atomically. Any start permit, start receipt, mismatch or uncertain state returns unconfirmed and retains reservation. Runtime separately requires worker.reconcile() === idle before freeing its local slot.
required_host_adapter.requestActiveCancellation: Add idempotent exact-lease store operation: match worker/attempt/hash, transition a running claim to stopping and the job to cancelled (or preserve already-stopping state), and retain reservation. This records intent only; runtime must observe the exact stopping lease before WorkstationWorker.cancel, and capacity releases only after its identity-bound stop receipt.
required_host_adapter.private_lease_surface: A narrow worker journal reader should distinguish exact unsealed active lease, explicit settled/idle state, and unknown/corrupt/missing. If C05 keeps missing journal as worker.reconcile idle for first-run convenience, the host adapter still must not treat missing journal as proof of the token or of idle when SQLite shows unresolved work; define a positive fresh-worker/no-live-attempt bootstrap path explicitly.

meaningful_sqlite_verification_matrix: Use a temporary file-backed CloudJobStore, real project/root registration, CloudWorkerQueuePort enrollment, and actual claim/permit/start/cancel ledger operations; no process/provider job launch is needed.

Claim then reopen the store: only the exact private journal token can match the persisted hash and return active; missing/corrupt journal with an unresolved row, random token, wrong worker, duplicate or expired lease all return unknown and preserve reservation. Assert database bytes never contain the token.

Observe running exact lease as not-stopping; request cancellation then observe stopping; replay request idempotently; mismatched lease never changes job or emits positive observation. Reservation remains until exact C05 stop proof is acknowledged.

Cancel an unstarted claim and assert atomic terminal-attempt/requeue semantics plus reservation release; race a permit or start-receipt insert before compare-and-cancel and assert it refuses without releasing capacity. User-cancelled or already-final jobs are never requeued.

Recovery matrices: journal active + SQLite active exact => active; active journal + hash mismatch/missing DB row => unknown; journal/worker says idle while DB has running/stopping/interrupted row => unknown; explicit no-unresolved store state plus valid worker idle proof => idle; corrupt journal/database uncertainty retains local slot and disables readiness.

Two enrolled slots share one CloudJobStore/SQLite connection; stopping/interrupted/permit-started reservations continue to reduce headroom and block retry until the right terminal/stop receipt is durably acknowledged.

Shutdown records active cancellation, observes stopping before process cancel, and a timeout or unavailable observation leaves slot/reservation ambiguous and held; reopening the same DB proves no duplicate claim is admitted.

Current store cancel API cannot safely stand in for either callback: it is keyed by job/version, is not idempotent for already-cancelled state, and lacks the unstarted no-permit/no-process compare-and-cancel guarantee.

A synchronous error emitted by kill re-enters onChildError -> fail, calls kill a second time, and wins settlement with spawn-failed instead of the original deadline/output-limit/child-failed reason. finish() immediately detaches child error/close listeners even when failure has only requested SIGKILL and the child has not emitted close. A later error in that interval is unhandled by the EventEmitter and can become an uncaught process error. Keep an error sink until close (while preventing a second Promise settlement), or otherwise demonstrate a safe terminal lifecycle.

deadlineMs is applied once to authority.acquire and then restarted at the full duration for runLocalCli. It therefore bounds each phase independently rather than the total acquire-plus-CLI operation.
